scope: Source-pinned finite engineering and actual production UI evidence for wrist/sleeve refinement. Historical anatomy evidence remains separate. No clinical, universal range, or AAA-quality claim.

independentAudit.scope: Independent read-only source/runtime audit of actual wrist ownership, material seam, reflected normals and target lifecycle. Production files not edited. Existing test suites not rerun by this reviewer. In-memory diagnostics plus this report only.

runtimeReview.status: No unresolved substantive correctness finding in final reviewed source snapshot. The critical source-trouser binding defect is resolved numerically; refreshed GPU bimanual proof belongs to root.

shaderReview.scope: Node source insertion checks only; no GPU shader compilation

reflectedNormalReview.method: Compared source implementation against Three0.180 skinnormal_vertex: bindMatrix -> weighted bone linear matrices -> bindMatrixInverse, then inverse-transpose targetToGroup and normalization. Left-hand negative scale is retained in target normal matrix; proper local frame built after reflected transforms.
reflectedNormalReview.numericalEndpointOracle: Covered by independent wrist regression agent and geometry agent; this reviewer did not rerun those suites.

findings.evidence: Source hand MeshPhysicalMaterial specularIntensity approximately0.64 versus stock MeshStandardMaterial dielectricF0=.04. Initial bridge blended albedo/roughness/emission/normals but not F0/F90.
findings.resolution: Geometry agent added material.specularColor/F90 interpolation after lights_physical_fragment; cache key v2. Current shader source insertion checks include both.

findings.evidence: Three WebGLGeometries.onGeometryDispose removes only the currently attached geometry.index. Swapping cached BufferAttributes could leave prior uploaded GL buffers unremoved.
findings.resolution: Root now keeps one original-capacity dynamic index attribute, copies CPU cached variants into its prefix and updates drawRange. All nine modes preserve attribute and typed-array identity.

findings.evidence: Inspection camera baked full index storage without copying drawRange, so unused live-index suffix could become phantom occluders after the GPU-allocation fix.
findings.resolution: director.inspectionMeshes now copies source drawRange to its baked geometry; separate regression agent covers empty/nonzero-start/count camera probes.

findings.evidence: Whole204-vertex trouser pieces previously split across arm and two leg owners, producing42source cloth outliers up to929.72mm. Final component-based ownership assigns each complete piece to its correct leg.
findings.resolution: Source topology connectivity determines anatomical piece; aggregate source-limb costs plus explicit wrist/hand arm seeds choose one owner, then per-vertex segment/t is recomputed against that owner. No source faces hidden, no camera or bone/foot/needle changes.

runtimeReview.compatibilityScope: Ownership capture intentionally recognizes the pinned long-sleeve figure topology: a separately tagged1531-vertex stock hand immediately follows a48-vertex bare-forearm block and a ten-sided separate flat cap. Older hand assets without interface metadata remove only stock hand faces and retain source forearm/cap. Short-sleeve or changed upstream topology is not claimed by this capture contract.

directorReview.inspectionMeshes: Baked world geometry copies source drawRange; Mesh.raycast therefore ignores unused original-capacity index-buffer tails. This prevents hidden stock-hand triangles becoming phantom inspection-camera occluders.
directorReview.insideSupportDepthScope: Manual nearest-depth loop is restricted to support-hand meshes, whose product GLB index drawRange is unchanged/full. Current actor body is not in that name filter.
directorReview.gpuPicking: New join meshes intentionally retain no-op scene picking, consistent with source figure mesh; inspectionMeshes creates normal-raycast baked proxies for them.

unchangedWristFrameLimitation.implementationDecision: Original two-bone poses, boneTurn frames and85-degree cap intentionally retained. New skin bridge does not establish full3D wrist alignment or remove the documented roll residual.

rejectedAlternative.reasonNotAdopted: Trades forearm residual for a large humeral/hinge reference rotation. Those mathematical frame angles are not calibrated clinical shoulder ROM; changing the reference must not be presented as naturally resolving the85-degree forearm limit.

postGpuCriticalFinding.oldCollapseComparison: Reapplying old arm t>2.01 collapse still leaves approximately750mm triangle[3691,3703,3692]. Triangle[3644,3656,3645] remains approximately739mm because wrongly arm-bound vertices have t1.73/1.96, below old collapse threshold. It is a pre-existing per-vertex nearest-limb binding defect, amplified/exposed in current capture; old camera did not prove healthy geometry.
postGpuCriticalFinding.requiredFix: Assign original connected source parts to one anatomical limb, then recompute each vertex segment/t against that part owner. Do not hide trousers or alter camera, feet, arm lengths, hand/needle pose or85deg cap. Vertexxsign is insufficient because four crotch vertices cross the midline.

afterFix.scope: Independent numeric reproduction of the actualPublic bimanual screenshot parameters and production tick order; not a replacement GPU screenshot.

loftGeometry.anatomicalTrackingScope: Original bone solve and85deg cap retained. Exact endpoint attachment does not imply that the underlying forearm dorsal frame matches the detail hand; independent root forearm audit reports those residuals.

actualUi.scope: Actual production UI and public controls. Full practitioner retained, no geometry substitution, private camera, scene hiding or image retouch; native rAF waits after public seeks. Software WebGL evidence, not AAA certification.

limitations: The authored85deg forearm cap and original IK wrist-frame residual are unchanged. A connected skin surface is not evidence of anatomically correct wrist tracking.

A faint circumferential shading trace remains visible in the optional three-finger close-up. Small chronological left-wrist creases remain at some approach/withdrawal poses; one held adjacent-face normal dot reaches about-.028. The measured finite cases do not certify every parameter combination.
Correspondence is fixed per activation and can differ between chronological and first-update-held initialization; it is not a unique anatomical material correspondence.
The low-reach endpoint trajectories can move rapidly; loft continuity measurements must be read alongside actual source/target boundary movement.

The production patient guard normally checks the articulated hand model. The added loft and hem were separately checked in twelve explicit finite cases; this is not continuous full-parameter clearance coverage.

Materials and shape remain procedural. Tissue pressure/friction, measured cloth mechanics, clinical motion capture and target-GPU performance are unverified. Software WebGL screenshots are not AAA production certification.
